ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Sound ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Light ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Care CARE AND SAFETY and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Safety CARE AND SAFETY and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
